title: Model of Flavors
summary: The BCS-motivated idea of Weinberg and Salam on dynamical EW symmetry breaking is revived: The Higgs sector of the EW gauge model of three fermion flavors (families) is replaced with the chiral gauge $SU(3)_f$ quantum flavor dynamics (QFD) strongly coupled at a huge scale $Λ$. I. With all chiral fermions in flavor triplets the anomaly freedom demands the welcome BSM extension of the SM fermion sector by one EW-sterile neutrino $ν_R$ per flavor. II.
